Extract metadata returns document metadata when enabled

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<html><head><title>Test Page</title><meta name='description' content='A test page'></head><body><p>Content</p></body></html>", HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(extract_metadata: true))
puts result.content.inspect
puts result.metadata.document.title.inspect
puts result.metadata.document.description.inspect
```
